svg.title: Stack — Shlok Singh
svg.desc: Stack: C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript; React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Flutter; Firebase, MySQL, OpenCV, YOLO; Docker, AWS, Git, Linux; ESP32, ESP8266 and Raspberry Pi. Clearly spaced labelled icons on three tilted elliptical orbits with animated tracers. Espressif brand marks identify the ESP32 and ESP8266 chips.

g.data-text: From the browser to the board.
